items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He had another one played, they called him Boot... See, I never met them.

ctx.x: So Sport must have been Lester's cousin.

He was. He had two of them. He had another one played, they called him Boot... See, I never met them. They used to talk about them all the time. He was a helluva trombone player. That was Sport's brother. So they was with the old man for a long time until they got tired of traveling around on the shows. They was on the Heck and Beck and Wallace circus. That was three guys on that circus -- Heck, Beck and Wallace.
And you say Boot and Sport were part of that?
